text.p: A light earthquake measuring 3.9 on the Richter scale on Thursday shook the Algerian capital, Algiers, and neighbouring areas, the Algerian official news agency APS said.
The tremor shortly after midnight was an aftershock to a powerful one on Wednesday that rocked Algiers and other regions, slightly injuring 13 people, said APS.

The 13 hurt by that quake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale were in Ain Benian and Bouchaoui areas in the coastal province of Tipaza, 60 km (40 miles) west of Algiers, said APS quoting local rescue services.
Wednesday's tremor split the walls of several old houses.
